Thanh Long.doi_thuong: the matter comes with joy and celebration, and help from people who think well of you

Chu Tước.doi_thuong: the matter involves what is said, papers and messages — say things clearly to avoid misunderstandings

Câu Trần.doi_thuong: the matter moves slowly, with lots of procedures, tied to land or an old place

Đằng Xà.y: worry, odd events, vagueness, roundabout ways
Đằng Xà.doi_thuong: the matter is still vague and full of doubts, easy to overthink — ask until it is clear

Bạch Hổ.doi_thuong: the matter is urgent and forceful, with some friction — act decisively and mind your safety

Huyền Vũ.doi_thuong: part of the matter has not come to light; loss or concealment is possible — check carefully and keep your things safe

tiến thần.doi_thuong: the matter takes one more step in the direction it is already going

thoái thần.doi_thuong: the matter steps back a beat and cools off unless you hold on to it

hồi đầu sinh.doi_thuong: this very change gives the matter extra strength

hồi đầu khắc.doi_thuong: the move is knocked back by its own result — if you act, plan your way out

hoá tiết.doi_thuong: the move drains your strength; you give more than you get

hoá khắc xuất.doi_thuong: you cut things back yourself — firm, but it takes effort

hoá tỷ.doi_thuong: it changes but stays the same in nature

phục ngâm.doi_thuong: marking time, groaning but not moving

phản ngâm.doi_thuong: flipping back and forth, changing your mind again and again

the_ung: In a hexagram, the Self line stands for you and the Other line for the person or matter on the other side.

mua_ban.cau_hoi: Are you buying or selling? The two are read from different lines of the hexagram.

tinh_cam.cau_hoi: To pick the right line for that person (in the Six Lines reading): is that person a woman or a man? You can skip this — the hexagram will then use the Other line for them.

hai_viec.cau_hoi: One hexagram can only shed light on one matter. Which would you like to look at first?

mau.phuc_than: What you asked about has not shown itself in the hexagram yet: the person or thing you care about is still in the background, and it is not yet time for it to appear.
mau.khong_hao_dong: There are no changing lines: the matter is quiet and no big shift is under way — read it by the hexagram's overall message.
mau.suc_khoe: This is a suggestion about daily rhythm from the old texts, not a substitute for a doctor — if anything feels wrong, get it checked.
mau.luc_do: Looking at the moment you asked, this matter has some support behind it — even though the hexagram's words still urge care. Use that support for the part you have already prepared well, and do not start anything new yet.
mau.mot_que_mot_viec: One hexagram, one matter: to ask about something else, ask a new question; for this matter, reflect on this hexagram rather than casting again.
